title: 奶树林下
year_display: 1953年纽约诗歌中心演出、1954年BBC播出（Britannica：presented at the Poetry Center in New York City in 1953, and its final version was broadcast by the BBC in 1954）
background: Britannica（B300）：'This play, which evokes the lives of the inhabitants of a small Welsh town, shows Thomas's full powers as an artist in comedy.'（威尔士小镇居民的生活——喜剧艺术的全盛）。
文体（B300 语境）：'verbal harmonies that are unique in English poetry'（英语诗歌中独一无二的语音和谐——B300）。
'His work……owed more to his Welsh background than to the prevailing taste in English literature'（B300）。

广播剧的声音艺术（通说）。
